reviews.title: Used to be great 😞
reviews.text: This app was previously great because of the integration with iCal. I would create all-day events for stuff I wanted to do in the future or recurring events (like fill a medication each month), and on the day it was due it would pop up on the corresponding list. A few weeks ago, this stopped working right. Now it lists recurring events days or weeks in the future, making the list excessively long. I have tried changing every setting I can think of but nothing fixes it. I tried contacting the developer through the app but got no answer. Such a shame, now I need to find a new app.

reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: How is this so highly rated? I like the simple, elegant design and almost intuitive interface. But the stability sucks. Do the developers even use it themselves? If they did they would encounter the basic usability bugs. Screen freezes. Keyboard not showing up. Showing wrong items in the wrong lists, ….. Makes me question all the five star reviews. I very much want this to work. It would be a great tool if they can address the issues

reviews.title: Greedy
reviews.text: I have had this app for over a year now bc I did love it and tbh I think all of the colors were free and you could choose and use whatever which is why it was a fav and it’s super simple.  Why the hell they JUST changed it and my colors I was using now has a lock on it asking me to pay.. and all I’m going to say is whoever made that decision needs to be taken out lord.

reviews.title: Color sorting doesn’t work and my wife can’t share with me :(
reviews.text:
Those are the only things holding this app back from 5 stars. I love it otherwise. 

But with color sorting not working there’s no meaningful way to organize a list efficiently. 

Additionally, my wife shares my license through the lifetime family option, and I suspect that’s the reason she can’t share lists.

I look forward to changing my review

reviews.title: Buggy//Never lets Mac sleep
reviews.text: I was so happy with this at first. I paid for the lifetime subscription and for the first week it worked great. Now, I can’t always change task colors, the iCloud sync requires the apps be open across devices at all times to sync properly, and my Mac never sleeps on its own because this app literally prevents it (activity monitor confirmed). It’s good in theory and meh in execution. I regret paying for this and plan to keep looking.

reviews.title: It’s pretty good
reviews.text: Just not great, you can only do so manny things without paying :|

reviews.title: Everything is lost
reviews.text: I have been using the app for a couple years now. Today ALL of my list disappeared and I have nothing in the app to help me find my list. I am very upset because I can’t even get access to support. The only way to supposedly get support is through the website,but the icon for Support does not connect to support. 🤬

reviews.title: SCAM NO SUPPORT DONT BUY
reviews.text: So complicated. Not easy to use at all and no where to ask for support or refund.

reviews.title: How
reviews.text: Idk how they managed to make an app called minimalist so confusing but they did. Its way over engineered and makes what should be a simple action of adding and checking off tasks, into something that takes multiple steps/screens and lists within lists to get through just to add a task. The most minimal list of all is a piece of paper and I should have just stuck with that lol

reviews.title: App updated randomly and deleted my whole list
reviews.text: I pressed on the app just now to add something, it refreshed, and must have updated to a newer, terrible, worse version. It deleted all of my lists without any warning, and the new version doesn't seem to work at all or have any of the functionality of the previous. I can't even add a new list.

reviews.title: dishonest developer
reviews.text:
purchased previous iteration of “minimalist pro” before the application developer decided to halt support of the minimalist pro app and only offer a “minimalist” app.  I sent emails several times “restore purchase results in error despite previous purchase of ‘minimilaist pro’ app also despite settings migrations from the now not supported ‘’minimalist pro’ to the currently supported ‘minimalist’ app.  please update so the restore purchase function actually functions and stop trying to swindle money from users

update: payment restore error zero despite purchase ~ attempted evasion of honoring payment suffered because of the actions of developer
update: approximately a year later and the lack of customer service to resolve the issue yearns at minimum a refund and compensation for false advertising and negligence

reviews.title: have to pay for everything now
reviews.text: used to have this app and really liked it. clean simple and functional. moved to paper lists for a while and wanted to come back to this app and now the functionality is SO LIMITED unless you pay! a limit of 2 lists unless you pay? and a subscription model? i don’t mind pay once but why is everything now a subscription. really a shame, i would keep using this if the functionality for the free version returned
